Educ’o’poil is a professional service distinguished by its attentive and caring approach to your pets. With walks tailored to each dog's specific needs, they offer an ideal solution for busy owners or those who simply want to enrich their four-legged companion's routine. The qualified staff makes it a point to respect the preferences and pace of each dog, whether young, old, or full of energy. If you are in Paris and looking for a reliable dog walking service, Educ’o’poil deserves special attention.

--- Don't let bad habits take root, start now and make your dog a perfectly trained companion! 🐾

Antoine has been taking care of my little Skye for almost three years now: he's a highly trustworthy professional, extremely kind, and always available! He's also always attentive and offers great advice on managing the emotions and behavior of our four-legged companions 🐾. I highly recommend him! Thank you so much, Antoine! …
Antoine is a fantastic trainer, sensitive to the animal's well-being, and gives invaluable advice! My dog ​​made tremendous progress immediately thanks to him. Thank you again for everything!
